verdict.rationale: The evidence documents install routes (npx skills add, Claude/Codex/Copilot plugin install) and updates (`npx skills update`), and a runtime probe confirms a selective install works. Nothing documents listing installed skills or uninstalling them cleanly. Deleting copied files by hand would be a user-side workaround, and the plugin managers' own commands are host-platform features, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions
